decisions.reason: Accepting HubSpot default reports does not change which communication channels are visible on lead records.
The reporting decision does not alter creating or managing lead lists in HubSpot.
The choice of default reports does not change MeetAlfred reply-status synchronization in HubSpot.
Replacing custom funnel reporting with default reports does not change HubSpot-to-MeetAlfred list synchronization.
The reporting-mode decision does not change the LinkedIn-to-Apollo-to-HubSpot transfer path.
Using HubSpot default reports does not affect creation or Zapier configuration of new MeetAlfred campaigns.
The reporting decision does not alter recirculation or follow-up handling of silent leads.
The source decision concerns report format and does not resolve or change which LinkedIn URL is stored in the CRM.
Accepting default HubSpot reports does not change the email integration with HubSpot and MeetAlfred.
The reporting change does not alter Apollo email enrichment or delivery of enriched contacts to HubSpot.
The reporting decision does not change the task-local policies protecting existing MeetAlfred campaigns and leads during testing.
The source decision concerns funnel reporting and does not resolve or modify duplicate-record visibility.
